'''Rod Latham Baragwin Retrieval''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst3.htm Baragwin Retrieval], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195633/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst3.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Event:''' [[1998 Shawn Valdez Tournament]]
* '''Played:''' August 1998

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 29th August 1998, 1 wins and 1 losses from 2 games (differential -13).<ref name="trandosite" />
